mentions.description: This app is an open-source spatial workspace for directing AI coding agents like an engineering director. It supports remote control from a phone and remote workers to scale beyond a single machine.

mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building an open-source "spatial workspace for directing AI coding agents like an engineering director".

I got overwhelmed by walls of text of parallel Claude Code sessions. This limited the sessions I could steer in parallel to maybe 5 or 6. I knew there had to be a better way, and I found one: A canvas per project. Work laid out as cards. An agent in a worktree per card. Chat condensed to WhatsApp-style back and forth, not a litany of tool calls. Result is usually a narrated demo video that I can comment on by voice to have the agent go another round. Remote-control from my phone. Remote workers to scale beyond my machine.
mentions.author: sadilek
